---
title: "Billboard Hot 100"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| message: false
billboard <- read_csv("data/billboard.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
billboard
```

```{r}
billboard_long <- billboard |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"),
    names_to = "week",
    names_prefix = "wk",
    names_transform = list(week = as.integer),
    values_to = "rank",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  )
```

```{r}
song_summary <- billboard_long |>
  group_by(artist, track) |>
  summarize(
    first_rank = rank[which.min(week)],
    best_rank = min(rank),
    first_week_at_best_rank = min(week[rank == min(rank)]),
    total_weeks = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

song_summary

notable_songs <- bind_rows(
  song_summary |>
    filter(best_rank == 1) |>
    arrange(first_week_at_best_rank, artist, track) |>
    slice_head(n = 1) |>
    mutate(notable = "Fastest to number one"),
  song_summary |>
    filter(best_rank == 1) |>
    arrange(desc(first_week_at_best_rank), artist, track) |>
    slice_head(n = 1) |>
    mutate(notable = "Slowest to number one"),
  song_summary |>
    filter(best_rank <= 10) |>
    arrange(desc(total_weeks), artist, track) |>
    slice_head(n = 1) |>
    mutate(notable = "Longest chart run among top-10 songs")
) |>
  select(notable, artist, track, first_rank, best_rank, first_week_at_best_rank, total_weeks)

notable_songs

billboard_top10 <- billboard_long |>
  semi_join(
    song_summary |> filter(best_rank <= 10),
    by = c("artist", "track")
  ) |>
  left_join(
    notable_songs |>
      transmute(
        artist,
        track,
        highlight = paste(artist, track, sep = " - ")
      ),
    by = c("artist", "track")
  )

ggplot(billboard_top10, aes(x = week, y = rank, group = interaction(artist, track))) +
  geom_line(
    data = billboard_top10 |> filter(is.na(highlight)),
    color = "gray70"
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = billboard_top10 |> filter(!is.na(highlight)),
    aes(color = highlight),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#D55E00", "#0072B2", "#009E73")) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  labs(
    x = "Week",
    y = "Hot 100 ranking",
    color = "Notable songs"
  )
```

```{r}
billboard |>
  summarize(
    across(
      c(wk1, wk4, wk10, wk20, wk40, wk76),
      list(
        missing = \(x) sum(is.na(x)),
        present = \(x) sum(!is.na(x))
      )
    )
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = c("week", ".value"),
    names_sep = "_"
  )
```
